input.question: PRD-001's blocker has survived three post-implementation rounds, so the workflow makes this your call. My own validation found the panel's diagnosis was wrong: the page currently renders ZERO of four goals, not a partial list. Three defects stack — the checked-in data has a JSON syntax error ("done":, in entry 3), fix round 2's hand-rolled string splitter is itself broken so even the three valid entries fail to parse, and fix round 1's try/catch sits below the parse and catches nothing. Separately, the test file §9 names was never written. I have a concrete root-cause fix the previous rounds never attempted: drop the runtime JSON parsing entirely (make goals.js a real JS array literal, so a bad edit becomes a visible load-time error instead of a silent one), render any incomplete entry as a visible "not reported" row rather than dropping it, and add the missing test. Do you want me to spend one more fix round on that (option i), or leave PRD-001 at Draft and ungated with the page broken as it is, and stop (option ii)? Note that option ii means the deployed page stays blank. Waiving the finding is not available to either of us here.
